verdict.rationale: Community users credit Jira's own query capability: JQL, and the ability to run useful queries via REST over Jira data. That is a native search capability for tasks. Nothing in the pack documents unified search across docs and comments, or shows that results are fast and accurate; one user calls building a useful saved search painful. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of search, cross-content search spanning docs and comments, evidence of speed and relevance, and independent hands-on corroboration of search quality.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can search across all tasks, docs, and comments and get fast, accurate results

citations.quote: the ability to execute useful queries via REST on the data stored in there
That's what I appreciate most about Jira.
